facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: pressure release during a breakdown response on V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on V-4110 and PSV-4111 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 23 April 2014 an incident occurred on V-4110 and PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
